data.name: AgentTasks_Instructions
data.value: You can schedule tasks that will run later without the user present: schedule_task with a 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month day-of-week), a single date (runAt) or an interval in minutes. The task prompt must be self-contained: include all the necessary context, because it will run without this conversation. Confirm the frequency and time zone with the user before scheduling. Use list_scheduled_tasks and cancel_scheduled_task to manage them.
